svg.title: BVG delay stream telemetry
svg.desc: Four abstract transit lines with trains in motion, stop events dropping onto an event-time axis, one event diverted into the late side output, and a rolling window sweeping a schematic punctuality series.
svg.text: late_events · side output, kept not dropped
sliding 1 h / 5 min runs alongside the tumbling window
schematic: throughput and punctuality not yet measured
